entities.name: Hras
entities.description: A sixteen-year-old man from the village of Sevalgr on Kaldheim, shaken by a monster that killed fellow villagers.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who met Hras and joined the war party.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: A leader of the Omenseekers who organized a war party.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A group that arrived to investigate the village's troubles.

entities.name: Sevalgr
entities.description: A village on Bretagard where villagers disappeared and died.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: The region of Kaldheim containing Sevalgr.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The harsh plane where Hras lives.

entities.name: Aldergard
entities.description: A forest the war party entered to confront the threat.

events.summary: Hras stepped forward fearfully to recount his encounter with a monster plaguing his town to Inga Rune-Eyes and the Omenseekers.
events.quote: he bravely stepped forward to share his account

events.summary: Hras's testimony prompted Inga to organize a war party and venture into the Aldergard forest with Kaya Cassir.
events.quote: This prompted Inga Rune-Eyes to organize a war party
